AS-08.title: How to add skills support to your agent

requirements.repository_control: Runtime admission requires direct skills/*/SKILL.md.
Frontmatter delimiters and parseable supported YAML scalars are required before a non-empty Markdown body.
Validator enforces 1-64 lowercase alphanumeric/hyphen names, no repeated separators through the regex, and parent-directory identity.
Validator requires a non-empty 1-1024 character description; package standard requires outcome and activation context.
Optional license frontmatter must be a non-empty string; adoption manifest separately requires reviewed license identity.
Optional compatibility frontmatter is validated at 1-500 characters.
Optional metadata is accepted only as a string-to-string map.

requirements.gap: The format permits an experimental field that has uneven client support.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Stricter rejection is deliberate because metadata cannot enforce repository authorization or containment.
requirements.repository_control: Repository rejects the experimental field at admission.
Validator requires instructions after frontmatter and does not impose a proprietary body schema.
Canonical skills use skill-root-relative, one-level supporting resources and the compliance gate resolves referenced resources.
Package standard keeps metadata compact, core instructions in SKILL.md, and conditionally loaded supporting resources.
Package standard sets <500 lines and preferably <5,000 tokens; the compliance gate checks the line limit for adopted skills.

requirements.gap: CI does not currently run the upstream skills-ref validator.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Keep the custom fail-closed gate; add a pinned skills-ref compatibility check only when it can run without violating dependency/runtime-installation policy.
requirements.repository_control: Repository custom validator covers the normative package fields and stronger local controls.

requirements.gap: Client guidance describes project/user/client and .agents scan scopes.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: The narrower core discovery boundary prevents untrusted external directories becoming repository runtime authority.
requirements.repository_control: Repository runtime discovery is deliberately limited to direct repository-owned skills; target installation/discovery paths belong to adapters.
requirements.section: Step 1: Discover skills / Where to scan

requirements.gap: Project-over-user precedence applies to multi-scope client discovery, not the repository canonical namespace.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Adapter/client implementations should define precedence if they expose multiple scopes.
requirements.repository_control: Repository runtime has one canonical skill namespace and rejects duplicate names.
Every adopted skill requires a trusted project and explicit provenance/approval controls.

requirements.gap: Client compatibility guidance suggests warning/lenient loading where possible.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Strict admission is deliberate for repository-owned governed artifacts; compatibility repair belongs before adoption, not at runtime.
requirements.repository_control: Repository admission fails closed on malformed frontmatter instead of repairing it leniently.
Catalog emits name, description, location, risk tier, activation mode, and content hash from validated adopted skills.
Global runtime kill switch returns an empty catalog before skill activation when disabled.

requirements.gap: Current repository evidence does not demonstrate one live target activation transport end-to-end.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain as an adapter compatibility gate and do not infer product behavior from package validity.
requirements.repository_control: Portable core keeps activation representation behind runtime adapters and records model/explicit activation mode.

requirements.gap: No current target-runtime evidence proves a user slash/mention or equivalent explicit activation surface.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Capture this in target-specific compatibility evidence when the ChatGPT adapter surface is exercised.
requirements.repository_control: Explicit activation is represented in adoption policy for higher-risk tiers.
References/assets remain packaged but are loaded only when SKILL.md directs; core does not eagerly inject them.

requirements.gap: No checked-in live-host evidence demonstrates permission allowlisting for bundled skill resources.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Verify per target before claiming seamless resource loading.
requirements.repository_control: Repository security policy declares allowed filesystem scope in adoption manifests but host permission prompts are adapter-owned.

requirements.gap: Current target does not expose reliable compaction-retention evidence.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Record as a target limitation until an observable compatibility test exists.
requirements.repository_control: Context compaction is treated as target behavior, not portable package authority.
requirements.section: Protect skill content from context compaction

requirements.gap: Activation deduplication is host behavior and is not currently observable.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Test only in a target adapter that exposes activation traces.
requirements.repository_control: No portable repository rule claims activation deduplication.
Adopted descriptions use imperative 'Use when' phrasing and user intent/outcomes rather than implementation mechanics.
Package standard requires realistic activation tasks, adjacent near-miss boundaries, and concise catalog metadata.
Evaluation standard requires positive, near-miss, conflict, and prompt-injection trigger cohorts with realistic variation.

requirements.gap: Guidance suggests about 20 with roughly 8-10 positive and 8-10 negative queries.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: The repository uses a smaller explicit minimum plus conflict/injection cohorts; teams may add more cases when risk warrants.
requirements.repository_control: Repository minimum is 6 positive + 6 near-miss + 2 conflict + 2 injection cases (16), prioritizing adversarial boundary classes over the guide's approximate 20-query target.
requirements.section: Designing trigger eval queries / query volume

requirements.repository_control: Harness requires exactly three observed trigger runs and applies 2/3 positive, <=1/3 near-miss, and strict conflict/injection boundaries.

requirements.gap: Trigger definition schema does not encode train/validation membership, so the split cannot be mechanically verified.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Add split metadata to trigger definitions and validate proportions before description-optimization runs.
requirements.repository_control: Evaluation standard requires an approximately 60/40 fixed train/validation split.

requirements.gap: No automated train-only revision/held-out selection loop is checked in.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Treat optimization as a separate evaluation workflow until an isolated activation runner is available.
requirements.repository_control: Repository standard prohibits query-specific overfitting and defines iterative evaluation, but current automated harness scores evidence rather than running description optimization itself.

requirements.gap: Fresh unseen sanity queries after description selection are not evidenced.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Add when description optimization becomes executable rather than structural-only.
requirements.repository_control: No repository gate currently records a fresh post-optimization trigger cohort distinct from training/validation definitions.
requirements.section: Applying the result / fresh sanity queries

requirements.repository_control: Output definitions require realistic prompts, expected outcomes, assertions, and human-review criteria; repository standard starts with three representative tasks including a boundary case.
Harness requires an explicit no-skill or previous-version baseline and symmetric candidate/baseline run numbers for observed outputs.
Test definitions live under tests/skills; generated iteration evidence lives under .work/evals and remains outside runtime packages.
Harness captures duration, token, tool-call, and retry metrics when observable and requires reasons when unavailable.
Output definitions require non-empty assertions with stable IDs, criticality, and verification method.
Observed output runs require PASS/FAIL assertion outcomes with non-empty concrete evidence.

requirements.gap: Assertion method strings are validated as text but the harness does not verify that mechanical assertions actually invoke deterministic graders.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Add typed assertion methods only if/when runner integration can enforce them without creating duplicate schemas.
requirements.repository_control: Repository standard prefers deterministic scripts for mechanical assertions and model judgment only where necessary.
Scorecard aggregates trigger, output, efficiency, verification, abuse, compatibility, human review, rollback, and operational telemetry.

requirements.gap: The harness does not automatically flag assertions that always pass/fail across both configurations.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Keep human pattern analysis required; automate only once repeated run evidence is available at useful scale.
requirements.repository_control: Repository evaluation standard directs review of inconsistent results, weak assertions, wasted work, and outliers.
Evaluation record requires human-review status, reviewer/date when complete, and feedback.
Evaluation standard defines a repeatable iteration loop and stores generated evidence per iteration.

requirements.gap: Why a run failed may be less diagnosable when the target does not persist execution traces.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Capture transcripts when the runner exposes them; do not fabricate unavailable traces.
requirements.repository_control: Evaluation guidance is incorporated into the standard, but scorecards do not require a transcript artifact.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires pinned repository-supplied dependencies and no runtime installation.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires skill-root-relative script references.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires non-interactive scripts.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires concise --help output with examples.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires helpful deterministic failure behavior.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires structured stdout and diagnostic stderr.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires idempotency or explicit unsafe-retry detection.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires rejecting ambiguous input and enforcing repository-relative scopes.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires read-only/dry-run defaults for stateful work.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires meaningful documented exit codes.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Security standard prohibits high-risk capabilities at P0 and package standard requires bounded safe defaults.

requirements.gap: No currently adopted repository skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Retain the admission rule and require deterministic script-specific tests when a script-bearing skill is proposed.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard requires bounded output where the host permits.

requirements.gap: The guide permits uv/pipx/npx/bun/deno-style self-contained dependency resolution.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: The stricter offline/pinned-dependency policy is a deliberate supply-chain containment measure.
requirements.repository_control: Repository prohibits runtime dependency installation, network retrieval, and auto-resolving runners during P0.
Adoption process is grounded in source artifacts, project authority, provenance, and concrete prior workflows.

requirements.gap: Current top-five evaluation records defer behavioral effectiveness where an isolated activation/output runner is unavailable.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Do not claim behavioral value until target execution becomes observable; continue storing governed deferrals.
requirements.repository_control: Repository evaluation loop supports execute-review-revise iterations.

requirements.gap: Execution transcripts are not a required scorecard field and may be unavailable from the target.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Capture and preserve traces when the runner exposes them.
requirements.repository_control: Evaluation standard directs trace review when available.
Package standard requires core-only instructions and the current adopted SKILL.md files are below 500 lines.
Canonical skills have bounded lifecycle responsibilities and delegate specialist methods instead of absorbing adjacent domains.
Package standard explicitly prefers lean core instructions and conditional references.
Adopted skills state when to load classification, lifecycle, artifact, style, and specialist references.
requirements.section: Structure large skills with progressive disclosure

requirements.repository_control: Lifecycle skills scale prescriptiveness by small/medium/complex classification and make high-risk gates explicit.
Package standard requires one clear default over equivalent menus; lifecycle skills define a default sequence.
Adopted skills define reusable lifecycle procedures rather than task-specific answers.

requirements.gap: Current lifecycle skills embed critical boundaries directly rather than maintaining separate gotchas headings.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Add named gotchas only when repeated execution evidence shows a distinct set improves reliability.
requirements.repository_control: Critical non-obvious safety boundaries must stay in SKILL.md when needed; a named gotchas section is not mandatory.
Current lifecycle skills include assets/templates where level-specific output structure benefits from concrete patterns.
Lifecycle references define gated multi-step progress and completion checks.
Required lifecycle includes implement/review/verify loops and repository validation gates.
Non-trivial repository changes require a plan before implementation and high-risk lifecycle work requires explicit review/verification gates.

requirements.gap: No current adopted skill contains a scripts/ directory.
requirements.remediation_or_justification: Add bundled scripts only from repeated execution evidence and with deterministic tests.
requirements.repository_control: Package standard permits scripts only when repeated fragile deterministic work earns their cost.

divergences.rationale: Portable metadata is not authorization; repository host/security controls remain authoritative.

divergences.policy: Discover only repository-owned direct skills in the portable core.
divergences.rationale: Multi-scope host discovery is adapter-owned and must not make external directories repository runtime authority.

divergences.policy: Fail closed on malformed adopted SKILL.md frontmatter.
divergences.rationale: Lenient repair is appropriate for client interoperability, not governed repository admission.

divergences.policy: Require 16 trigger cases minimum with explicit conflict and prompt-injection cohorts.
divergences.rationale: The source query count is approximate; repository minimum invests cases in adversarial boundaries and permits larger sets.

divergences.policy: Prohibit runtime dependency resolution/network installation at P0.
divergences.rationale: Stricter offline dependency containment reduces supply-chain and execution risk.

triggers: Any audited source artifact hash changes.
Agent Skills specification or baseline source register is refreshed.
Evaluation definition or effectiveness harness contract changes.
A script-bearing canonical skill is proposed or admitted.
A runtime adapter changes discovery, activation, resource loading, permissions, or context handling.
